captions.detailed: A cinema zoom lens with a matte black finish, featuring a wide front barrel and a tapering body. It includes three distinct geared control rings: a wide focus ring, a medium-sized zoom ring, and a narrower iris ring near the rear mount. Each of these three rings is designed to rotate continuously and independently around the central axis of the lens body.
captions.instruction: Generate a 3D model of a cinema zoom lens with a wide front barrel and three independently rotating, continuously rotatable geared rings (focus, zoom, and iris) spaced along its tapering body, finished in matte black.
captions.factory: Construct a base lens body using a combination of concentric cylinders of varying radii, hollowed out at the front. Create three separate geared rings by generating a base cylinder for each, adding small polar-patterned rectangular ridges along their outer circumferences to simulate gear teeth, and then hollow them out. Assemble the components using continuous joint articulations that allow each ring to rotate coaxially around the main lens body.
